description: A `:name` segment in a path. Its value is available as `route.params.name` and is always a string (or string array when repeatable).
`:id(\\d+)` restricts what a param matches, e.g. digits only.
Key/value pairs after `?` in the URL, exposed as `route.query`. Not declared in the route record.
Passes `route.params` to the routed component as props, decoupling it from `useRoute()`.
Navigating between URLs of the same record keeps the component instance; watch the param instead of relying on `onMounted`.
In-component guard called when the route changes but the component is reused.
